d: Bangal ki khari se uthe chakravati tuphan arnab ne desh ke mausam ka mijaj puri tarah badal diya hai…bangladesh ki or se ornab nam diya gaya ye tuphan teji se tatiy ilakon ki taraph barh raha hai… mausam vibhag ne aaj yani 27 aktubar ko dakshin, madhy aur purvi bharat ke kaee hisson men bhari se bhari barish ki chetavni jari ki hai.. samudr men 140 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se chalne vali tej havaen aur oonchi lahren tabahi macha sakti hain... aandhr pradesh aur odisha men red alart jari kar diya gaya hai.. vahin uttar bharat ke maidani ilakon se lekar purvottar tak is tuphan ka…
